name: Velvet Antenna Core v0.10.0
author: James
description: Velvet Antenna base viewer shell: persistent navigation, home hero, core cards, library tabs and viewer styling.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.12.1
author: James
description: Detail and library layer. v0.12.1 preserves Jellyfin's native Series and Season detail pages so season and episode rendering remains functional, while retaining Velvet Antenna cinematic detail treatment for playable items.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.14.1
author: James
description: Design expansion with stable deterministic Home hero selection. v0.14.1 removes the lastHero anti-repeat rule that caused two Continue Watching items to ping-pong on every DOM mutation.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.15.0
author: James
description: Reliability pass: hides hero selection churn while the home page settles, makes More Info navigate directly, makes Play use Jellyfin's own player via a safe detail-page handoff, and gives non-playable series/folders explicit View/Open actions.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.17.5 Functional Hotfix
author: James
description: Functional hotfix preserving strict local playback routing and genuine Jellyfin subtitle/library controls. This release also publishes source-level v0.12.1 Series/Season compatibility and v0.14.1 Home hero stability fixes.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.20.4 Standalone
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna release. v0.20.4 fixes duplicate filtering so unresolved cards cannot leak into duplicate results, requires corroborating title evidence for provider-ID matches, and retains Needs ID, native multi-select, playback, Series/Season and metadata-management functionality.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.21.1 Velvet Lens
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna redesign focused on speed and a distinct browsing identity. v0.21.1 upgrades the whole-library admin workbenches with an inline Identify workflow for unmatched media, poster-level resolution badges for duplicate candidates, and confirmed direct deletion through Jellyfin, while retaining persistent Back navigation, Velvet Lens browsing, stable Home hero, strict local playback, native Series/Season rendering and subtitles.
